# HanaKotoba - Japanese Language Learning Platform

## Project Overview

Full-stack Japanese language learning platform with React (TypeScript) frontend and Django backend, featuring AI-powered tools for kanji recognition, mnemonic generation, pitch accent, and flashcard creation.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS
- **Backend**: Django 4.2, Django REST Framework, SQLLite
- **AI Integration**: OpenAI API, TensorFlow.js for kanji recognition
- **Deployment**: Docker, Docker Compose
